settings.title: Number of projects
settings.summary: The most projects you may have.
settings.description: The most projects a person may have, archived ones included, from 1 to 10000.

settings.title: Project name length
settings.summary: The longest name a project may have.
settings.description: The most characters a project's name may have, from 1 to 500.

settings.title: Project instructions length
settings.summary: The longest instructions a project may have.
settings.description: The most characters a project's instructions may have, from 0 to 200000. The instructions go into every call of every chat in the project, at the start, so a provider can cache them.

settings.title: Files in a project
settings.summary: The most knowledge files one project may have.
settings.description: The most knowledge files one project may have, from 0 to 500.

settings.title: Project file size
settings.summary: The largest knowledge file a project takes.
settings.description: The largest knowledge file a project takes, in bytes. A larger one is refused. Until uploads give a route a body limit of its own, server.max_body_bytes bounds it too.

settings.title: Project file types
settings.summary: The kinds of text file a project takes.
settings.description: The endings of the files a project takes as knowledge files, separated by commas. A file must be UTF-8 text with no zero bytes. Its text is read once, when it is added, and goes into every call of the project's chats.

settings.title: Project file text sent
settings.summary: How much of one project file's text goes into a call.
settings.description: The most characters of one knowledge file's text that go into a call, from 100 to 1000000. The rest is left out, with a note. All attachments together take no more than chats.context_attached_percent of a call.

settings.title: Project instructions heading
settings.summary: The line a model reads before a project's instructions.
settings.default: This chat is in the person's project "{name}". The person wrote these instructions for every chat in it:
settings.description: The line before a project's instructions, at the start of every call of a chat in it. {name} becomes the project's name. Nothing is sent when the project has no instructions.

settings.title: Project file heading
settings.summary: The line a model reads before a project file's text.
settings.default: A knowledge file of the person's project "{project}": {name}. Its text:
settings.description: The line before a knowledge file's text, with the attachments of every call of a chat in the project. {project} becomes the project's name and {name} the file's.

settings.title: Project file cut note
settings.summary: What a model is told when a project file was cut short.
settings.default: [The rest of {name}, {chars} more characters, is left out.]
settings.description: The line after a knowledge file's text that was cut to projects.file_context_max_chars. {name} becomes the file's name and {chars} the number of characters left out.

settings.title: Project memory space
settings.summary: Where a new project's chats keep the facts they remember.
settings.description: The knowledge store space a new project's chats keep their facts in, as the memory pass writes them. {slug} becomes the project's name in lower case, with a hyphen for each run of other characters. Empty keeps a new project's facts in knowledge.memory_space with the rest. Each project keeps the space it was given, and a held chat's facts go to knowledge.memory_sensitive_space or nowhere, whatever its project.

settings.title: Recall the project first
settings.summary: Recall in a project chat looks in the project's own space first.
settings.description: Whether recall in a project chat searches the project's memory space first, and gives what it finds there before what it finds elsewhere.
